name: plain-panel
description: Signals for working web tools: hardware control, experiments, procedures. Plain HTML, one store, no build step. Builds on plain-site.

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test test/*.test.js && npm run typecheck
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p examples/demo/jsconfig.json && tsc -p templates/jsconfig.json && tsc -p test/types
scripts.server: uv run --with fastapi --with uvicorn --with websockets examples/demo/server.py

author: James Wiles (https://github.com/Zaffer)
